source: AHN DTM 0.5 m (Rijkswaterstaat et al., PDOK WCS dtm_05m), CC0
resampleNote: Mesh is 96x96 over 2800 m: area-average of valid 0.5 m DTM pixels per cell (rasterio.warp.reproject, Resampling.average, onto a regular EPSG:4326 grid over the frame's box; RD grid north is rotated ~0.4 degrees from true north). The DTM has no data under buildings or over water; 212 of 9216 cells had no valid pixel at all and take their nearest valid neighbour. For the mesh only: the nodata mask is kept for guard G6. Heights are NAP metres and may be negative. AHN version served: 4 (flown 2020-2022). Row 0 is the SOUTH edge.
